scheme_name: Pre- Matric Scholarships Scheme for Scheduled Castes & Others
other_conditions: Applicant must be an Indian national.
For Component 1, the student must be studying full‑time in class IX or X and belong to a Scheduled Caste.

For Component 2, the student must be studying full‑time in classes I‑X, and the parent/guardian must be engaged in manual scavenging, tanning & flaying, waste picking, or hazardous cleaning, irrespective of caste or religion.
No family income ceiling applies for Component 2.
Only one scholarship can be availed at a time for classes I‑X.
The awarding body must be notified if the student receives any other scholarship.
benefits_summary: Day scholars receive Rs. 3500 per annum; hostellers receive Rs. 7,000 (Component 1) or Rs. 8,000 (Component 2) per annum, with an additional 10% allowance for disabled students.
